$comment: OPTIONAL Playwright-attach fallback for Claude Code (NOT for Cowork, which uses the Claude in Chrome tools). OFF by default: inert until you wire it into your Claude Code MCP config. It ATTACHES to a Chrome you start yourself with remote debugging, so you stay logged in and pass bot walls (a fresh browser gets HTTP 429/403). IMPORTANT (Chrome 136+): remote debugging is IGNORED when --user-data-dir is your DEFAULT profile — use a DEDICATED profile dir and sign in there once. Setup:  '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir="$HOME/.chrome-basivo"  (sign in to your sites in that window on first launch), then enable this server. No credentials or cookies are handled by basivo-operator. Snapshots/screenshots go to --output-dir (outside your repo); stage upload files there too, since uploads must come from an allowed root.
